roles.name: Tank
roles.description: Tank heroes soak up damage and shatter fortified positions, like closely grouped enemies and narrow chokepoints. If you’re a tank, you lead the charge.

roles.name: Damage
roles.description: Damage heroes seek out, engage, and obliterate the enemy with wide-ranging tools, abilities, and play styles. Fearsome but fragile, these heroes require backup to survive.

roles.name: Support
roles.description: Support heroes empower their allies by healing, shielding, boosting damage, and disabling foes. As a support, you’re the backbone of your team’s survival.

lines: Now has a 0.25 second minimum deploy duration.
dmon.dev: Power Barrier’s changes are intended to make deploying the barrier more of a commitment and improve its readability for enemies. Propulsors will retain its knockback while no longer dealing impact damage, reducing Dmon’s burst potential. Overstrike’s lifesteal is also being reduced to limit the total health it can provide.

lines: Added a new UI element that tracks allies within range and allies
junker-queen.dev: Junker Queen’s lower health pool can limit her ability to engage when she’s unable to apply Wounds and benefit from their healing. Increasing her base health improves her survivability, while reducing Carnage’s cooldown provides more opportunities to use it when enemies are within range.

lines: Burning damage over time increased from 15 to 20.
mauga.dev: Recent changes to Mauga have reduced his overall effectiveness, with his win rate falling below acceptable bounds. Restoring some of his base armor improves his survivability, while increasing his burning damage rewards igniting enemies without placing additional emphasis on enemy Tanks.

ramattra.dev: Increasing Void Accelerator’s ammo improves Ramattra’s ability to apply sustained pressure at range while outside of Nemesis Form.

lines: Healing per second reduced from 35 to 30.
winston.dev: Since Barrier Projector’s cooldown was reduced, Revitalizing Barrier has become more effective due to its increased uptime. We’re slightly reducing its healing output to compensate.

lines: Can no longer hit the same target multiple times per use.
Cast time reduced from 1.2 to 1 second.
anran.dev: Removing Inferno Rush’s knockback and ability to hit the same target multiple times limits its effects during a single use. Increasing Zhuque Fans’ damage improves Anran’s effectiveness at longer ranges and provides more opportunities to set up ignitions with her primary fire. Vermillion Ascent’s cast time is also being reduced to allow it to be used more reactively during skirmishes.

lines: Now additionally refills ammo on use.
echo.dev: Aerial Munitions will now also refill ammo, increasing its value and reducing the need to reload immediately after use.

lines: In addition, we've added some small quality-of-life changes for Emre's reticle settings for his default (custom) reticle, as well as fixing some minor visual inconsistencies with how these settings we
Added Rotation reticle setting for default reticle.
Removed Thickness reticle setting for default reticle.
Fixed visual inconsistency regarding default reticle crosshairs not using Outline Thickness and Outline Shift values.
Updated default reticle preview in Options to more closely reflect in-game reticle.
Detonation time reduced from 0.6 to 0.5 seconds.
emre.dev: Reducing Cyber Frag’s detonation time improves its responsiveness and makes it a more reliable tool for finishing off targets.

genji.dev: Recent changes to Genji have improved his ability to secure eliminations and enabled a more aggressive playstyle. Reducing Deflect’s duration places greater emphasis on timing while limiting its defensive uptime.

lines: No longer overrides Sombra's hacked health packs.
hanzo.dev: Sonic Disruption will no longer override Sombra’s hacked health packs, preventing either hero from overriding a health pack already controlled by the other.

reaper.dev: Recent changes to hitboxes and projectile sizes have reduced Reaper’s overall effectiveness. Increasing his base health improves his survivability and helps compensate for these changes.

lines: Starting spread reduced from 8.5 to 5.7 degrees.
Cast time/move time per volley reduced from 0.6 to 0.5 seconds.
shion.dev: Reducing Execution’s starting spread makes it more reliable at close range without requiring a full charge. Satsuriku Spree’s time between movement and firing is also being reduced, allowing Shion to reposition more quickly and reducing the delay between volleys.

lines: Overhead leap speed reduced from 11 to 9.5.
Initial swing delay increased from 0.15 to 0.2 seconds.
Raging Storm perk horizontal knockback reduced from 8 to 4.
vendetta.dev: Recent changes have increased Vendetta’s overall lethality. Increasing Palatine Fang’s initial swing delay slows down her attack combinations, while reducing the Overhead leap speed makes her movement easier to track. Whirlwind Dash’s knockback is also being reduced with Raging Storm equipped to limit the repeated displacement from multiple hits.

ana.dev: Recent changes increasing Biotic Grenade’s self-healing also increased its burst damage against enemies. We’re separating its damage and healing values to reduce its offensive power while preserving the increased self-healing.

lines: Added a new UI element that tracks allies within range and allies currently affected by Regenerative Burst.
Internal cooldown reduced from 1.25 to 1 second.
brigitte.dev: The addition of instant healing to Inspire has improved Brigitte’s healing output, but has had a limited impact on her ability to sustain herself and allies during fights. Increasing its instant healing and reducing its internal cooldown provides more frequent healing during sustained engagements.

lines: Primary Fire recovery time increased from 0.6 to 0.65
doctrine.dev: Doctrine’s healing output has remained high relative to the additional utility he provides. Increasing Eternal Sceptre’s Primary Fire recovery time reduces his overall output, while the reduced Infused values lower his burst potential. Increasing the cooldowns of Shrouded Momentum and Infuse places greater emphasis on thoughtful use of both abilities throughout engagements while maintaining their

lines: Time to maximum charge reduced from 0.65 to 0.575.
Heal per projectile increased from 40 to 50.
illari.dev: Recent projectile size changes have reduced Illari’s overall offensive effectiveness. Reducing Solar Rifle’s Primary Fire charge time places less emphasis on individual shots while increasing her overall damage output, reinforcing her strength as a high-damage Support. Healing Pylon’s output is also being increased to strengthen Illari’s defensive setups when positioned effectively.

lines: Acceleration increased from 25 to 28 meters per second.
Fuel regeneration rate reduced from 25% to 20% per second.
jetpack-cat.dev: Jetpack Cat’s survivability has remained strong alongside her high aerial mobility. Reducing her base health limits the survivability and aggression enabled by that mobility while preserving it as a core strength. Frenetic Flight’s acceleration is also being increased to enable faster repositioning, while its reduced fuel regeneration limits how frequently it can be used.

lines: Now overrides enemy hack effects on health packs.
sombra.dev: Hotfix’s duration provided enough uptime that choosing when and who to use it on carried less weight. Reducing its duration places greater emphasis on those decisions while retaining its effectiveness when used well.
